title: Kaption game manifest
description: One file per game: games/<id>.json, where the file name is the wire id. Read by the desktop (embedded at build time), the site, the backend catalog and the updater tests. Validate with: node tools/games/validate.cjs

id.description: Wire id: R2 keys, D1 `game`, CLI --game, the bundle's game. Always gameId lower-cased. Never changes.

gameId.description: Desktop GameId: Config["Game"], the %APPDATA%\Kaption\<gameId>\ folder and the Game_<gameId> string key. Never changes.

shortName.description: Label for tight spots (the site's game chips).

status.description: planned: catalog and vote only. beta, live: desktop and site. withdrawn: nowhere.

aliases.description: Other spellings of gameId that Config.json may hold. They resolve to this game's desktop profile.

legacyIds.description: Other wire ids older tools used for this game (starrail was hsr). Only the loose lookups (art, accents) read them; desktop profile lookup never does.

rect.description: A region as fractions of the 16:9 reference area inside the game window.

requireTitle.description: true: a process counts as the game only while one of its windows has a title from windowTitles. For generic engine executables such as Unreal's Client-Win64-Shipping. Absent means false.

pacing.description: Per-game OCR pacing defaults. A key left out means the global default (GameOcrTuning). Bounds are the resolver's clamp.

vision.description: Every key optional; a key left out keeps the shipping (accent) default.

classifier.description: Speaker/body split. accent: the name is in an accent colour. geometry: the name is the narrow top row (name and body share a colour). speaker-row: the name is the top row of a centred dialogue column, accent-coloured or in a larger font; rows that start right of the column are side panels.

ocrJunkFilter.description: Drop HUD readouts, watermarks and stray glyphs (OcrTextJunkFilter) before the speaker/body split on every frame. The geometry classifier always does.

dialogueEvidence.description: Paint a match only when the dialogue data vouches for it: a dialogue-graph line, or a known speaker saying something that reads as speech. Map labels, menus and item text are TextMap keys too.

fadedReadFilter.description: Treat a read whose body boxes are barely lit (under 2% of pixels past the binary threshold) as empty: the line is fading out, and keeping it would hide the fade from the change gate.

dialogueContext.description: Dialogue strategy set. Only passthrough exists; anything else fails closed like an unknown game.

upstreamTextMap.description: Runtime TextMap mirror for the source languages. none: the bundle carries the map (minted key space).

displayModeTip.description: The one-time display-mode tip before the first start.

playerNameTokens.description: The player's default name as the subtitle text spells it, each replaced by the name set in Settings. Left out: Traveler and traveler, the app's behaviour before manifests.

notes.description: For maintainers: which values are measured and which are provisional. No consumer reads it.

accent.description: The game's accent on dark surfaces (site, desktop dark palette).

accentDark.description: The accent deepened for light surfaces (desktop light palette). Defaults to accent.

glow.description: The Start hero's glow behind the art. Defaults to accent.

elementHues.description: Element colours this game draws differently from the shared table, or adds (English element names).

hub.description: Public URL slug. Never changes for an existing game.

guideKey.description: guide-pages.ts key of the game's guide (honkai for Star Rail).

ogBackground.description: Key art for generated update images, relative to landing/.

guessName.description: The daily guessing game's own name on the site (Gendle). Unique across games.

sources.description: auto: the VPS updater's packs. community: accepted player suggestions.

hoyolabGid.description: HoYoLAB game id; null off HoYoLAB.

officialFeeds.description: Official news sources the news worker reads, keyed by kind.

oneOf.description: An official YouTube channel (its RSS feed).
Kuro Games' official site news list (JSON).

codes.description: null: the game has no redeem codes. hoyolab: the news worker reads the HoYoLAB codes panel and the site has a codes page with a redeem link. ingame: codes are redeemed only inside the game; the site's codes page shows Copy and the in-game steps (redeemHow) instead of a link, and the news worker reads the sources [news.games.<id>] names (the official Discord follow, the wiki, the checked list).

officialDiscord.description: The game's official Discord server (guild id). Messages its announcement channels crosspost into the channel [news.games.<id>] discord_follow names are an official codes source next to the HoYoLAB panel; nothing else in that channel is.

redeemHow.description: Where a code is entered inside the game, as the game's own English UI labels: the site and the code alerts word the steps per language around them.

path.description: The menus from the main screen to the code field, in order (Terminal, Settings, ...).

unlock.description: The progress that unlocks the code field (Union Level 2), English game terms; absent when it is open from the start.

officialDiscord.description: The game's official Discord server (guild id). Messages its announcement channels crosspost into the channel [news.games.<id>] discord_follow names are an official codes source; nothing else in that channel is.
